Every closed trade is checked against your plan: entry, stop, size and target. Entry context. The market at the moment you filled, saved with the trade: regime, days to earnings, RS rank. Reviews that write themselves. One click drafts your daily, weekly or monthly review from your own trades. My Playbook. Your setups side by side, each with how it has actually worked for you. Setups board. Every setup you are watching on one board, sorted by how close it is to your entry. Reporting soon. Names you follow that report in the next week, with a prep note one click away.
